name: Puglia, Italy

rent.notes: Immobiliare.it Oct 2026 asking rents: Puglia EUR 9.33/m2/mo (+4.1% y/y), Bari 11.71, Lecce 8.74, Brindisi 7.90; a 100 m2 pet-friendly 2-3BR ~EUR 870-1,170. Numbeo June 2026 3BR outside centre: Lecce EUR 840, Bari 1,001.

healthcare.notes: National: voluntary SSN registration for elective-residence retirees (7.5% of income to EUR 20,658 + 4% to EUR 51,646; EUR 2,000/yr minimum, EUR 2,789 max per person) = ~EUR 335-345/mo for two; typical adds one basic Italian supplementary policy (EUR 800-2,000/yr), useful given thinner southern public capacity; max adds intermediate private cover for both.

healthcare.system: Italian SSN. Policlinico di Bari for major care. Rural areas have less coverage.
healthcare.waitTimes: Public: 4-12 weeks. Private clinics in Bari and Lecce offer faster care.
healthcare.prescriptionCoverage: SSN covers essential prescriptions with tiered co-pays

pros: Beautiful Baroque architecture (Lecce is 'Florence of the South')
Excellent food and wine at very low prices

pros.text: Stunning coastline and trulli houses in Ostuni/Alberobello (Trulli of Alberobello are UNESCO World Heritage)

sources.title: UNESCO World Heritage List — Trulli of Alberobello (787)

pros.text: 7% flat tax on foreign-source income for 9 years for new residents in qualifying southern-region municipalities <20K population (TUIR Art. 24-ter / Decreto Crescita 2019)
